voice.instruct: Calm, clear and friendly, like a good teacher explaining an idea for the first time. Steady pace.

beats.s0b0: The derivative of a function tells us how fast it changes at a point. Picture the curve y equals f of x, and one point on it.
beats.s0b1: The derivative at that point is the slope of the tangent line: the line that just grazes the curve there.
beats.s1b0: Watch the tangent line slide along the curve. Its slope changes from point to point.
beats.s1b1: That changing slope, written f prime of x, is the derivative: a new function, where each value is the slope of the curve.
